title: stat -J record
description: One file described by `stat -J`. Error records (`#/$defs/error`) are in the same stream. One record per line (NDJSON); version 1 of the Dogfish record format (doc/ndjson.md). Fields may be added in later releases.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

size.description: st_size: the length in bytes (of a symlink: of its target name).

mode.description: The permission bits (including set-user-ID, set-group-ID and sticky) in octal, as `0644`.

mode_symbolic.description: The mode as `ls -l` shows it, as `-rw-r--r--`.

user.description: The owner's user name; absent when the ID has none.

group.description: The group name; absent when the ID has none.

dev.description: The device number of the file system holding the file.

rdev_major.description: Of a device file: its major device number.

rdev_minor.description: Of a device file: its minor device number.

mtime.description: Last modification: RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

mtime_ns.description: Last modification: nanoseconds since the epoch.

atime.description: Last access: RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

atime_ns.description: Last access: nanoseconds since the epoch.

ctime.description: Last status change: RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

ctime_ns.description: Last status change: nanoseconds since the epoch.

btime.description: Birth (creation), where the file system records it: RFC 3339, UTC, with nanoseconds.

btime_ns.description: Birth (creation), where the file system records it: nanoseconds since the epoch.

io_block.description: st_blksize: the preferred I/O block size.

target.description: Of a symlink (without -L): what it points to, as stored.

target_bytes.description: The bytes of `target`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`target` then holds the lossy form).

error.description: An error record: the structured twin of a diagnostic the tool also printed on standard error, in order with the other records.
The diagnostic as printed on standard error, without the `tool: ` prefix.

path.description: The file the diagnostic names first, as given.

path_bytes.description: The bytes of `path`, base64, present only when they are not UTF-8 (`path` then holds the lossy form).

errno.description: The system error number, when the diagnostic ends with its message (2 for `No such file or directory`).
